prompt: A cinematic film still captures the bustling interior of a fire station bay. On the left, a firefighter in a soot-stained helmet stands next to a gleaming red engine. In the center, a dalmatian with black spots sits calmly on a polished concrete floor. To the right, a mechanic in blue overalls leans against a tool chest. A captain in a crisp white shirt points at a large wall map hanging above. A rookie in an oversized jacket looks at the captain intently. Near the entrance, a woman in a yellow raincoat hands a clipboard to a dispatcher in a gray suit. A brown leather boot rests on the bottom rung of a metal ladder. A silver coffee mug sits on a wooden desk beside a ringing telephone. A small child in a pink dress holds the hand of the woman in the yellow raincoat. A tabby cat sleeps on top of a stack of old newspapers. A bright orange hard hat lies on its side near the dalmatian. A folded newspaper rests under the silver coffee mug. There is no smoke filling the air. There is no visible fire burning anywhere. The firefighter in the soot-stained helmet touches the side of the red engine. The mechanic in blue overalls looks at the tabby cat. The dalmatian with black spots is positioned between the red engine and the tool chest. The captain in the crisp white shirt stands next to the rookie in the oversized jacket. The dispatcher in the gray suit sits on a rolling office chair. The small child in the pink dress stands next to the brown leather boot.
